text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for compulsory stop controls for westbound traffic on Keystone Avenue and on Ethelwin Avenue at its uncontrolled three-way intersections with Cedarvale Avenue in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate safe traffic flow.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Keystone Avenue at Cedarvale Avenue. 2. Authorized compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Ethelwin Avenue at Cedarvale Avenue.
